text:
Renee P.: Quick design review: new monitoring dashboard mock. Plot area looks fine but axis labels and smoothing controls are confusing to users. Thoughts?
Owen L.: I noticed folks keep toggling smoothing on/off instead of adjusting intensity. Maybe a single slider (0-100) with a default at 30 would be clearer than a binary toggle + hidden advanced.
Min J.: Agree a slider is more discoverable. Could show step presets (Off / Low / Medium / High) under the slider for keyboard users.
Samira H.: Also: axis unit labels currently use shorthand (k, m). For some teams this hides precision. Suggest a hover-to-expand pattern: show compact unit on canvas + full unit on focus/hover.
Renee P.: Good. For accessibility, hover alone won't work. Make sure focus reveals the expanded unit and there's an aria-label like "Y axis units: thousands (k)".
Owen L.: On outliers: current approach clips extreme values and draws a small caret at the edge. People didn't realize the caret indicates clipping. We should add an explicit "Showing clipped values" flag in the chart footer with a count.
Min J.: Or a tiny pill near the axis: "+12 clipped" that opens a modal listing the values. That helps for audits.
Samira H.: Copy suggestion for the pill: use "Hidden outliers: 12" rather than "clipped" 12 might read better for non-visual folks.
Renee P.: I like "Hidden outliers". Action item: make it keyboard-focusable and announce via SR: "12 hidden outliers, press enter to view".
Owen L.: For legend groups: some dashboards have series grouped (e.g., infra vs app). Instead of one long legend row, render collapsible groups in the legend panel with group headers you can toggle. Keeps skim readability.
Min J.: Implementation note: keyboard nav within the legend should support arrow keys to move between legend items and space to toggle series visibility. Document this in the a11y spec.
Samira H.: UX microcopy: under panel settings change "Smoothing" to "Smoothing intensity" and show a helper: "Use smoothing to reduce short-term noise; higher values blur spikes."
Renee P.: Also add a small link to open an "Explain smoothing" tooltip that shows before/after mini-sparkline examples. That helps non-analyst users.
Owen L.: Telemetry: can we capture if users adjust smoothing per-panel? Would like to see default drift.
Min J.: Yep, we'll log smoothing_value on interaction. We'll also persist per-user per-panel preference if the user toggles "Remember legend & smoothing" in panel settings.
design-bot: Tagging @min for telemetry, @samira for copy, @owen for interactions.
Samira H.: I'll prepare the tooltip copy and examples and upload images.
Min J.: I'll add the smoothing_value metric + clipped_outliers_count. Also add a flag to enable the grouped legend by dashboard.
Renee P.: Plan: 1) replace toggle with slider + presets, 2) compact unit + focus-expansion + SR label, 3) explicit "Hidden outliers: N" pill with modal, 4) collapsible legend groups + keyboard nav, 5) copy updates. Target prototype next Thurs.
Owen L.: I'll prototype keyboard flows and a11y announcements.
Samira H.: I'll finalize the microcopy and helper content.
Min J.: I'll wire metrics and preferences; will ensure no perf regression.
Renee P.: Thanks all. If nobody objects we'll include these in the next design QA. :white_check_mark:
